discussion.title: [P10] Explain the 8 km APN null-response band before promotion freeze

conclusion.primary: The 8 km delta is numerically null because the APN=0 baseline already reaches a sub-centimeter nearest-distance floor in this deterministic geometry.
conclusion.plumbing_check: CVA convergence and nonzero PN/APN command contributions occur before nearest approach, so the null nearest-distance delta is not an APN plumbing failure.
conclusion.scope: This explains the selected synthetic corner geometry only and does not freeze a real-world performance envelope.

hypothesis_disposition.time_to_go_or_maneuver_phase_alignment: not_supported_as_primary_cause: estimator convergence stays fixed while time-to-go changes smoothly across the sweep
hypothesis_disposition.pn_baseline_near_local_optimum: supported: APN=0 nearest distance remains below 1 cm throughout the null band
hypothesis_disposition.acceleration_estimator_transient_timing: not_supported: CVA converges before nearest approach in every run
hypothesis_disposition.scenario_grid_placement: supported: 8 km lies inside a 7.0-8.5 km floor band and the response becomes non-null at 9 km
